metrics.label: Mean annual temperature
metrics.describe: Average air temperature across the whole year.

metrics.label: Hottest-month maximum
metrics.describe: Typical daily high in the hottest month of the year.

metrics.label: Coolest-month minimum
metrics.describe: Typical daily low in the coolest month of the year.

metrics.label: Diurnal temperature range
metrics.describe: How far the temperature swings between day and night.

metrics.label: Heat-stress days
metrics.describe: Days per year above the crop or livestock heat threshold, when growth stalls and animals stop feeding.

metrics.label: Heat-humidity index
metrics.describe: Temperature-humidity index in the worst month. In humid air, sweat and panting stop working long before the thermometer looks alarming: above about 78 a cow stops gaining weight and a shaded pond still loses oxygen.

metrics.label: Annual rainfall
metrics.describe: Total rain falling in an average year.

metrics.label: Driest-month rainfall
metrics.describe: Rain in the driest month. This, not the annual total, decides whether you need irrigation.

metrics.label: Wettest-month rainfall
metrics.describe: Rain in the wettest month, which sets how much water your drains must carry.

metrics.label: Dry months per year
metrics.describe: Months receiving under 60 mm, too little to keep most crops growing without stored water.

metrics.label: Longest dry spell
metrics.describe: Longest run of consecutive days with negligible rain, averaged over the record.

metrics.label: Rainfall variability
metrics.describe: How much the annual rainfall swings from year to year. High values mean you cannot plan on an average year.

metrics.label: Solar radiation
metrics.describe: Sunlight energy reaching the ground, which caps how much a crop can grow.

metrics.label: Relative humidity
metrics.describe: Air moisture. Persistently high humidity raises fungal disease pressure.

metrics.label: Peak wind speed
metrics.describe: How hard it blows on a windy day: the 98th percentile of the daily maximum ten-metre wind over thirty years, so a strong day rather than one record gust. It matters for tall perennials, which topple or snap. Observed, and the same figure under every climate scenario — the projections behind this tool change temperature and rainfall, not wind.

metrics.label: Reference evapotranspiration
metrics.describe: Water a reference grass crop would lose to the air over a year: the demand side of the water budget.

metrics.label: Annual water balance
metrics.describe: Rainfall minus evapotranspiration. Negative means the site runs a water deficit and needs storage or irrigation.

metrics.label: Elevation
metrics.describe: Height above sea level.

metrics.label: Slope
metrics.describe: Steepness of the ground. Steep land erodes, and machinery cannot work it safely.

metrics.label: Aspect
metrics.describe: Compass direction the slope faces.

metrics.label: Topographic wetness
metrics.describe: Topographic wetness index: how strongly the shape of the land concentrates water here. High values stay waterlogged.

metrics.label: Height above drainage
metrics.describe: Height above the nearest stream or drain. Low values flood first and drain last.

metrics.label: Flood hazard
metrics.describe: Combined flood exposure from height above drainage, wetness and slope, scaled 0 (safe) to 1 (floods regularly).

metrics.label: Erosion exposure
metrics.describe: How hard the rain, the soil and the slope would work on this ground if it were left bare, scaled 0 to 100 against the most exposed ground in the district. Rainfall erosivity from NASA POWER, erodibility from SoilGrids texture and carbon, slope from SRTM. It is not tonnes per hectare and deliberately leaves out crop cover, which is the part you decide.

metrics.label: Soil pH
metrics.describe: Soil acidity. Below 4.5 aluminium becomes toxic to roots; above 7.5 iron and zinc lock up.

metrics.label: Clay content
metrics.describe: Share of clay-sized particles. Clay holds water and nutrients but drains slowly.

metrics.label: Sand content
metrics.describe: Share of sand-sized particles. Sand drains fast and holds little nutrient.

metrics.label: Silt content
metrics.describe: Share of silt-sized particles.

metrics.label: Soil organic carbon
metrics.describe: Organic carbon in the topsoil: the core measure of soil health, structure and water holding.

metrics.label: Cation exchange capacity
metrics.describe: Cation exchange capacity, the soil ability to hold onto nutrients instead of letting them leach away.

metrics.label: Bulk density
metrics.describe: How compacted the soil is. High values mean roots struggle and water ponds.

metrics.label: Total soil nitrogen
metrics.describe: Total nitrogen held in the soil.

metrics.label: Soil texture
metrics.describe: USDA texture class from the clay, silt and sand mix.

metrics.label: Soil drainage
metrics.describe: How readily water leaves the soil profile, from very poorly drained to excessively drained.

metrics.label: Available water capacity
metrics.describe: Plant-available water the soil can store in the root zone: your buffer against a dry spell.

metrics.label: Peat depth
metrics.describe: Depth of peat. Deep peat subsides and acidifies when drained, and is a major carbon store.

metrics.label: Mean soil moisture
metrics.describe: Satellite-observed average water content of the soil.

metrics.label: Dry-season soil moisture
metrics.describe: Satellite-observed soil water content during the driest part of the year.

metrics.label: Distance to surface water
metrics.describe: Straight-line distance to the nearest watercourse, where a watercourse is any cell the elevation model says enough land drains into. Derived from the terrain rather than read off a map, so a drain nobody has mapped still counts and a dry gully may count too.

metrics.label: Water temperature
metrics.describe: Estimated pond water temperature: mean air temperature, corrected for this cell's elevation, plus about a degree for a shallow tropical pond. Modelled rather than measured, and it moves with the climate scenario.

metrics.label: Mean NDVI
metrics.describe: Average greenness. Shows where vegetation already grows well.

metrics.label: NDVI seasonal amplitude
metrics.describe: How much greenness swings through the year, which reveals the existing cropping rhythm.

metrics.label: Daytime land surface temperature
metrics.describe: Daytime surface temperature measured by satellite, usually hotter than air temperature over bare ground.

metrics.label: Land cover
metrics.describe: What currently covers the ground: cropland, forest, water, built-up and so on.

metricGroups.label: Climate
metricGroups.description: Temperature, rainfall, sunlight and evaporation through the year, and how they are shifting.

metricGroups.label: Terrain
metricGroups.description: The shape of the land: how steep it is, where water collects, and how far above the nearest drain it sits.

metricGroups.label: Soil
metricGroups.description: What the soil is made of, how acidic it is, and how much water and nutrient it can hold.

metricGroups.label: Water
metricGroups.description: Soil moisture through the seasons and access to surface water.

metricGroups.label: Vegetation
metricGroups.description: What already grows here, how well, and how it responds to the seasons.

classes.label: Highly suitable
classes.description: No significant limitation. Expect close to the full yield this enterprise is capable of, with normal management.

classes.label: Moderately suitable
classes.description: Workable, with limitations that reduce yield or raise costs. Most land that farmers actually farm sits here.

classes.label: Marginally suitable
classes.description: Severe limitations. Viable only with careful management, and returns will be slim in a bad year.

classes.label: Not suitable as-is
classes.description: Fails on at least one requirement today, but the limitation is one that investment can fix. The platform will cost and size that work for you.

classes.label: Permanently unsuitable
classes.description: Fails on something that cannot practically be changed, such as open water, built-up land, or ground too steep to farm safely.
